method_card.title: Venn Diagrams & Conditional Probability
method_card.content:
Venn diagrams show overlapping sets. \(P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)\). The region outside both circles = \(P(\text{neither})\).

Conditional probability: \(P(A | B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}\). Read as 'probability of A given B has occurred'.

Fill in a Venn diagram from the intersection first, then work outward. Total of all regions = 1 (or the total number of items).
method_card.example:
30 students: 18 like football, 12 like tennis, 6 like both.

Football only: 12, Both: 6, Tennis only: 6, Neither: 6. P(football | tennis) = 6/12 = 1/2.
